ReviewBot is an automated MR review bot (not a human) on the **Platform Engineering / Atlas team** (gitlab.examplecorp.example/platform-eng/atlas). It runs automated code reviews on Atlas merge requests, delivering structured findings with priority levels (P1=critical, P2=important) via GitLab comments and email summaries. Alex Chen responds rapidly to its feedback — often pushing fixes within hours.

The chosen metric is a distribution-based symmetric KL divergence between predicted-probability and label-probability histograms (per priority class, averaged), with a single-number rollup of 1 - normalized_KL rescaled to 0–100. The driver was the 12% inter-annotator noise floor on the golden set — re-labeling would only reduce it to 6%, not zero, and model improvements inside the noise band would still be uninterpretable.
